title: Precision Agriculture Technology for Crop Farming
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: This book provides a review of precision agriculture technology development, followed by a presentation of the state-of-the-art and future requirements of precision agriculture technology. It presents different styles of precision agriculture technologies suitable for large scale mechanized farming; highly automated community-based mechanized production; and fully mechanized farming practices commonly seen in emerging economic regions. The book emphasizes the introduction of core technical features of sensing, data processing and interpretation technologies, crop modeling and production control theory, intelligent machinery and field robots for precision agriculture production.
